Cards: the derived 1NT rebid range under a 1NT opening from 13 or 14 (G9-B10 item 4)

When a card does not state its 1NT rebid range, it was derived as the range above the 1NT opening whenever the
opening started at 14 or lower: 17-17 for a 14-16 notrump, empty for 14-17. Now a 1NT opening from 13 or 14 with two
points or more below it gives the balanced minimum under it, as a strong notrump does: (11, 13) for 14-16 with 11-point
openings, (12, 13) for 14-17 with 12. Weak notrumps keep the range above.

No built-in card bids or reads differently: only rb-precision's derived range changes (17-17 to 11-13, which is what
the rule bidder it describes rebids 1NT with, balanced 11 to 13 on 175 of 6,000 deals), and its card does not cover
rebids. Tests pin the built-in ranges; the card suites pass (68 passed, 3 skipped). The card-intake report's note,
which said the fix would change rb-precision's calls, is corrected.
